name: HRB Legal Reader
summary: A legal document intelligence workflow focused on making complex and difficult-to-read legal documents more accessible through document processing, OCR, structured extraction, and AI-assisted understanding.
problem: Complex and difficult-to-read legal documents are hard to parse and understand. HRB Legal Reader is a workflow focused on making that material more accessible.
solution: A document intelligence workflow that combines document processing, OCR, structured extraction, and AI-assisted understanding to make complex legal documents more usable.
targetUsers: Built around the need to make complex, difficult-to-read legal documents more accessible; the portfolio does not specify individual roles or organisations.
businessApplications: Making complex legal documents more accessible
